Description:
Traveling this harsh environment, you spot an unusually ornate stone - it's a monolith, tribute to the sun and the forest. You are passing through a druid's domain, and he or she might just be watching you from the eyes and form of a woodland critter, ready to leap upon you as a mighty wolf, or in the form of an otherworldly creature of the forest. Travelers beware!
Druids are guardians of their domain, be it a lush forest, a barren wasteland, the peak of a mountain, or the depth of the sea. Most druids can transform into various animals, some even able to invent their own fauna and flora to shape their domain, while others forgo nature entirely to focus on studying the old ways of the cosmos.
A druid is a spellcaster heavily attuned to their environment, who can shapeshift into animals, cast nature magic and channel the old powers of the stars themselves.
Quick Note: A druid is a spellcaster heavily attuned to their environment, who can shapeshift into animals, cast nature magic and channel the old powers of the stars themselves.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Druid-specific abilities are considered spells (unless stated otherwise).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Recommended Abilities Description: You can provide healing and utility to your team with Healing Surge and Speak With Plants, deal flexible damage and Crowd Control with Poison Burst and Intelligence Blast, and provide buffs to your party with Wild Dexterity.

Whistletone:
Whistletone is the art of conveying information at long distances through whistles, claps and snaps. Druids specifically can also incorporate magic into their Whistletone to mimick the breeze of the wind, the subtle sound of thunder in the distance, or even replicate smells and miasmas to convey hidden messages.
You can write down Whistletone as one of your spoken languages.

Starting Abilities Description.Domain: The Domain is your key feature as a Druid: try to make the most out of both your domain and the domain you're currently in. It may be worth asking your Quest Master what kind of environments to expect, and avoid getting those as your primary domain (since you will get the boons from it anyway)!

Starting Abilities Description.Regrowth:
A helpful little Spell that you can use once per Adventure. It's not much, but you can do all sorts of interesting things with it, especially since you can farm Health with it.
You can combo it with Ripstorm or Innervate for a second use of those Abilities. If you use it with the Nature Domain, make sure it's for an Ability that uses lots of dice, like Lightning Storm, Ripstorm or Brineborne Lullaby.

Starting Abilities Description.Shapeshift:
Note that you can get Shapeshift as a Level 1 Minor Talent. While entirely optional, there are many great Talents that work with and improve upon Shapeshift.
The Shapeshift Spell provides an infinite amount of options to help out your party in any situation!

~Domain~.Effect:
Choose a _domain environment_ from: {Brown('Nature, Water, Air, Earth')}.
Your Abilities may have extra effects based both on your _domain_, and the current _environment_.
~Domain~.Upgrade: The Quest Master determines what environment you're in. It's possible to not be in any domain (e.g. urban areas, interiors, etc).
~Domain~.Notes: Nature (Forests, Jungles, etc), Water (Lakes, Swamps, etc), Air (Fields, Mountains, etc) and Earth (Deserts, Caves, etc).

~Regrowth~.Effect:
Your next Ability or animal feature is improved based on your and current _domains_.

{Brown('Nature:')} Dice Upgraded to next die type, twice.
{Brown('Water:')} Heal an ally you can see for 1d4 and restores 1 Mana to them
{Brown('Wind:')} Before or after cast, quickly dash up to 10 meters
{Brown('Earth:')} +2 Max Health to you or one of the Ability's targets

~Druidcraft~.Effect:
You can create harmless sensory effects, tiny weather effects or soothe mild pains.
You can speed up the growth of small plants by 1000% while channeling.
You can speed up the progress of a disease or illness by 1000% while channeling.

~Control Wind~.Effect:
You can control gusts of wind in a 6x6x6 area and do one of the following for 1 Action:
{Diamond} Create Heavy Wind blowing from any direction (see notes) that lasts for 1 minute
{Diamond} Move Heavy Wind 3 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Create wind that makes Units fall softly
{Diamond} Stop it (for 0 Actions)
{Diamond} Push all Units in the wind 1 meter in the wind's direction
~Control Wind~.Notes:
Moving against Heavy Wind acts as Hard Terrain.
Projectiles fired against the Wind have -1 Damage, and projectiles fired with the Wind gain +1.
Multiple Winds don't stack into eachother.
Heavy Wind also clears Fog, Smoke, etc in the area.

~Fog Cloud~.Effect: A 5x5x5 meter cube becomes covered in fog for 1 minute.
~Fog Cloud~.Upgrade: All Attacks done from, through or to Units inside Fog have Cover (-50%).
~Fog Cloud~.Notes: Fog can be dissipated by wind. You can choose the color of the fog. The fog does not go through walls, but does bend around corners (e.g. up to 360 degrees around wall extremities).

~Wild Steed~.Effect:
You call upon a ridable land animal native to the area you are in.
You and up to 1 more party member can ride this animal.
It follows the normal rules for Riding.
It does not participate in combat.
~Wild Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 6, this can be a flying animal.

~Shapeshift~.Duration: Until cancelled (0 AP) or you Fall
~Shapeshift~.Effect:
Transform into a medium-sized animal or a mystical beast resembling one you've encountered this Campaign. It has 2 features of choice from below (up to your Level).
While Shapeshifted, you can Animal Attack for Half-Action.

~Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

~Shapeshift~.Notes:
Your animal's Stats are 3/1/0/-1 spread as you like (for Rolls only).
You can only cast _some_ Abilities while Shapeshifted.
You choose what items you keep on you when Shapeshifting, and those items are 'merged' into your new form.
While Shapeshifted, you can speak, but your voice is slightly altered to match your shape (e.g. guttural for lions, high pitched for birds, etc).

SpellTable.Name: Hefty
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, gain 3 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each. You are Long (2x1 meters) and Ridable.

SpellTable.Name: Clawed
SpellTable.Effect: Your animal features listed here have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Sweep {Action}2 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / Shapeshift
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take 2d4 + Your Highest Stat (any type). If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Bash {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 2 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit and deal 1d4 Smash Damage to it.
{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.

SpellTable.Name: Venomous {Level}Level 3
SpellTable.Effect: Animal Attacks deal +1d4 Damage to Units affected by Crowd Control. {Combo} +1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Fast {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: You have +3 Movement Speed. You can freely Break Movement.

SpellTable.Name: Sticky {Action}1 Action Point {Range}3 meters {Level}Level 5
SpellTable.Effect: Shoot a sticky substance at a Unit. It takes 1d4 Damage, becomes Double-Slowed and apply a Combo. Usable once per Shapeshift.

SpellTable.Name: Shred {Action}2 Action Points {Level}Level 6
SpellTable.Effect: Attack a Unit for 2d8 + 3 Slash Damage. Deals +1d8 Damage for each level of Stun on it.

SpellTable.Name: Leap {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 7
SpellTable.Effect: Leap at a Unit 2-3 meters away. Deal 2d6 Pulse Damage and apply a Combo. {Combo} it becomes Frail.

SpellTable.Name: Fly {Level}Level 8
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly up to your speed. You take -50% Smash Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Large {Level}Level 9
SpellTable.Effect: You have 2 Defense. You are Large (2x2 meters) and Ridable.

~Thornskin~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
Whenever it is melee attacked, the attacker takes 1d4 Pierce Damage.

{Brown('Earth:')} 3 Damage instead of 1d4.
{Brown('Nature:')} Apply a Combo to it.
~Thornskin~.Notes: A Unit can only be effected by one Thornskin effect at a time.

~Everbloom~.Effect:
Heal an alive Unit for 2d10.

{Brown('Water:')} +1d6 Healing
{Brown('Wind:')} +1d6 Healing.

~Venin Spike~.Effect:
Shoot a venomous spike at target, dealing 1d6 + ^Sense^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, shoot another spike at it, which finds its target no matter the range or line of sight.

{Brown('Nature:')} Shoot the extra spike now.
{Brown('Water:')} 1d8 Damage instead (on both spikes).
~Venin Spike~.Notes: Body parts count as weapons. The second spike ignores Cover.

~Ripstorm~.Effect:
Deal 3d10 Damage to all Worthy Units within 2 meters of you.
Heal for 1 Health per 5 real Damage done (total).

{Brown('Earth:')} One of the Units hit becomes Crippled.
{Brown('Wind:')} +1 range and only hits Enemies

~Biological Study~.Effect:
Choose an enemy. Guess one of its Stats (you choose which).
If you were right, your next weapon attack against it deals +1d8 Damage and repeat this.
~Biological Study~.Notes:
You can't guess the same Stat twice on the same Unit type.
For example, if you guess correctly twice, your next 2 real weapon attacks deal extra Damage agains it. If you guess 3 times, your next 3 attacks. And so on.

~Wild Heart~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units gain 1d4 Health Regen, each.

{Brown('Nature:')} +1 Unit affected.
{Brown('Water:')} 1d6 instead.
~Wild Heart~.Combo: A Comboed target gains +1 Max Health permanently.

~Wind Chaser~.Effect:
Your next targeted attack or Spell curves around obstacles, ignoring Cover and dealing +1 Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} +1d4 Damage instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} And Slows it.
~Wind Chaser~.Notes: You still need Line of Sight to the target.

~Earth Shield~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each.

{Brown('Earth:')} 1d6 instead.
{Brown('Nature:')} 3 Shieldings instead.
~Earth Shield~.Notes: Lasts for 24 hours or until you rolled the d4 3 times. Does not stack multiple times with itself.

~Nami~.Effect:
Send out a 4x1 meter wave forward. Each Unit* hit takes 2d8 Cold Damage.
The first Unit hit is Slowed.

{Brown('Water:')} Allies hit are Healed for 1d6 instead of taking Damge.
{Brown('Wind:')} 6x2 meter wave instead.
~Nami~.Notes: If in a Water environment/domain, Allies are Healed and Enemies are Damaged. Otherwise, all Units hit are Damaged.

~Self Preservation~.Effect: Whenever you cast a Spell and you target yourself, it has ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Self Preservation~.Notes: This applies even when targeting multiple Units and you're one of them. {DiceUpgrade}

~Domain Animal Attack~.Effect:
{Brown('Nature:')} ~Heal for 10% of the attack's Damage (at least 1).~
{Brown('Earth:')} ~Taunt the target.~
{Brown('Water:')} ~+2 range.~
{Brown('Wind:')} ~1d8 Damage instead of 1d6.~
~Domain Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

<Innervate>.Effect: Heal another ally for 4d4 Health, it regains 1 Mana and provides 1 more use of an Ability that is on Cooldown.
<Innervate>.Downside: Can not be cast on Druids.

~Elderform~.Effect: You have extra available features originating from the flora and microbiomes of the outdoors.

SpellTable.Name: Photosynthesis
SpellTable.Effect: You regenerate 1d4 Health at the end of every Turn.

SpellTable.Name: Brambles
SpellTable.Effect: After you are attacked from 1 meter away, deal 1d4 Damage back to the attacker.

SpellTable.Name: Petals
SpellTable.Effect: At the end of the Adventure, the Quest Master gives you an additional positive Quirk.

SpellTable.Name: Inner Flame
SpellTable.Effect: Your Animal Attack has 5 meters range and deals Fire, Cold, Shock or Poison Damage.

~Cutting Winds~.Effect:
A Unit takes 2d6 + ^Your Dexterity^ Slash Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} Push it 3 meters (any direction).
{Brown('Water:')} +1d6 Damage

~Roots~.Effect:
All Enemies within 4 meters of you take 2d6 Pierce Damage and become Double-Slowed.

{Brown('Nature:')} 6 meters instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} 2d8 Damage instead.

~Lightning Storm~.Effect:
Choose a 4x4x4 meter cube.
All units inside take 3d4 Shock Damage now. If a unit carries anything made of metal or is wet, it takes 100% more Damage.

{Brown('Wind:')} 4d4 Damage instead.
{Brown('Nature:')} The Damage triggers again at the start of your next Turn in the same area.

<Brineborne Lullaby>.Effect:
Choose yourself.
Heal the chosen Unit for 1d8 for each 10 Health it is missing, and all Units within 2 meters of it for half the final amount just Healed.

{Brown('Water:')} For each 7 Health missing instead.
{Brown('Earth:')} Choose any Unit instead.

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.

~Child of the Feral~.Effect:
When you get this Talent, choose a Shapeshift animal feature from below, up to your Level.
You have that feature when not Shapeshifted.

SpellTable.Name: Clawed
SpellTable.Effect: Your animal features and weapon attacks have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Sweep {Action}2 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take 2d4 + Your Highest Stat (any type). If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Bash {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 2 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit and deal 1d4 Smash Damage to it.
{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.

SpellTable.Name: Venomous {Level}Level 3
SpellTable.Effect: Your attacks and single-target Spells deal +1d4 Damage to Units affected by Crowd Control. {Combo} +1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Fast {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: You have +2 Movement Speed.

SpellTable.Name: Sticky {Action}1 Action Point {Range}3 meters {Level}Level 5 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect: Shoot a sticky substance at a Unit. It takes 1d4 Damage, becomes Double-Slowed and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Shred {Action}2 Action Points {Level}Level 6
SpellTable.Effect: Attack a Unit for 2d8 + 3 Slash Damage. Deals +1d8 Damage for each level of Stun on it.

SpellTable.Name: Leap {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 7
SpellTable.Effect: Leap at a Unit 2-3 meters away. Deal 2d6 Pulse Damage and apply a Combo. {Combo} it becomes Frail.

SpellTable.Name: Fly {Level}Level 8
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly at half of your normal Movement Speed. You take -50% Smash Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Large {Level}Level 9
SpellTable.Effect: You have 1 Defense. You are Large (2x2 meters) and Ridable.

~Nativity~.Effect: Every ~real hour~, regain up to {Mana}0.5 Mana.

~Runeback Form~.Effect:
Your animal forms become improved by visible tattoos, runes or trinkets adorning your horns, paws or back.
Depending on your and current _domain_, you gain additional powers when Shapeshifted.

{Brown('Earth:')} When Shapeshifting, gain 1 Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.
{Brown('Nature:')} When Shapeshifting, permanently increase your Max Health by 0.5.
{Brown('Water:')} You do +10% Damage and Healing while Shapeshifted (at least +1).
{Brown('Wind:')} You can cast any of your Spells while Shapeshifted and have +2 Movement Speed.
~Runeback Form~.Notes: You can't have actual Health in fractions. So, for every second time you get 0.5 Max Health, increase it by 1 instead.

~Celestine Regrowth~.Effect:
Your next Ability or animal feature is improved based on ~any 3 domains you choose~:

{Brown('Nature:')} Dice Upgraded to next die type, twice.
{Brown('Water:')} Heal an ally you can see for 1d4 and restores 1 Mana to them
{Brown('Wind:')} Before or after cast, quickly dash up to 10 meters
{Brown('Earth:')} +2 Max Health to you or one of the Ability's targets

<Dazzling Miasma>.Effect:
Shoot a tainted gust of spores in a 10x1 meter line.
It hits the first 2 Units it travels and:

{Brown('Earth:')} Double-Stun them.
{Brown('Nature:')} Deal 4d6 Poison Damage to them.
{Brown('Water:')} Heal them for for 4d6.
{Brown('Wind:')} Give them 4 Shieldings that can block 1d6 Damage each.

~Fairy Fire~.Effect:
Choose a 5x5x5 meter area.
All Units, traps, invisible objects, magical items and hidden paths in that area become outlined in a glow, even if invisible.
~Fairy Fire~.Upgrade: Their glow is even visible through walls, but the denser the walls, the less they appear to glow.
~Fairy Fire~.Notes: A 1-meter thick concrete wall completely blocks the glow.

~Water Breathing~.Effect: Up to 2 allies you can see (can include yourself) can now breathe under water.

~Tree Stride~.Effect:
While within 30 meters of trees, you have +1 Movement Speed.
You can climb trees without making Rolls, using your normal Movement.
You can use as many meters of your Movement as you like to jump that distance from one tree to another.

~Camouflage~.Effect:
You and all your pets (if any) become camouflaged and turn effectively invisible and causing no sound, undetectable by the naked eye.
While camouflaged, your Movement is halved.
You appear, however, in mirrors, reflections and in recordings (as well as your sounds).

<Third Kind>.Effect: When Shapeshifting, choose one additional Animal Feature to have.

<Evershape>.Effect: Shapeshifting yourself doesn't cost Mana, but it has a Once / Combat Cooldown.

<Call of the Wild>.Effect:
Call upon 2 animals, both of which are specific to your or the current _domain_.
They appear on the edge of the battlefield, from the wilderness, and they fight for you for up to 1 minute.
Each has 1 Action with which they can Move and Attack, normally. You can control them on your Turn.
<Call of the Wild>.Notes: Both animals must be of the same type.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Land Bonus>.Effect: Gain one more Level 3 Talent or one more Domain.

<Landscaping>.Effect:
An area 1d8 kilometers in diameter centered on you changes to match your _domain_, and, when casting this, you can shape the earth, plants, sky, etc within 100 meters to your liking.
Also, passively, while in your _domain_, you have all your ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type (and d12's become d20's), and You automatically pass all Hard Sense Checks (that require at least 15).

<Embrace Gaia>.Effect:
You gain the effects of all (4) Domain Abilities.
While in your primary _domain_, Nature Spells cost no Mana.
You are immune to normal diseases and ailments, and you can not die from old age, but your body continues to age indefinitely.

<Ultimate Shapeshift>.Effect:
Once per Adventure, you can transform into a Beast, Fey, Monster, Plant or Dragon you have previously interacted with that is worth at most 1000 XP using Wild Shape.
If it's an Epic Monster, you can use that many of its Abilities on your turn instead of doing your regular Action.
Also, passively, your Might and Intelligence increase by 1.

<Apex Predator>.Effect:
Your Animal features have no Cooldown, their Stats are tripled, all Damage they (and Animal Attack) do is doubled, and you have +Half-Action per Turn while Shapeshifted.
You automatically pass all Very Hard Sense Checks (that require at least 20).
